entities.summary: Chakri, a notable figure in the history of Thailand, associated with Thonburi and Early Rattanakosin (1782–1851). Preceded by Chakri Dynasty Founding and Early Bangkok and Rama I founds Bangkok (Krung Thep) and the Chakri dynasty. Their legacy influenced Bowring Treaty and Mongkut.
